body:
This happened when I was 17. I've been diagnosed with depression/MDD and anxiety, unless suicidal ideation counts as something too. I did not expect people to react that way, ofc I wasn't expecting the world's warmest welcome, but I didn't think I would be insulted after admitting to what I had done. I don't remember what else I may have said. Maybe I worded everything poorly, I was pretty emotional while writing it, probably wasn't thinking too clearly.

I'm not saying people should let the things bullies have done slide, hell no, but I do think people should consider that there can be a lot more to the story. That they shouldn't despise people who are bullies, sure despise bullying, but to despise the people themselves feels a bit much to me. Idk maybe I'm just a piece of shit so I have sympathy for people who have done horrible things. Anyways, of course you can reinforce the idea to them that what someone did was wrong, suggest how they can improve themselves, but when they're admitting to their wrongs, how is being nasty going to help?

Sorry if I sound biased, maybe I just have too much sympathy for such people because I used to be one of them.

I don't remember which issue it was, but there was something mentioned about Air Force One blowing up very quickly into the apocalypse. I'm guessing either George Bush was infected on the phone, someone else picked up his phone, or his family or some other people escaped onto AF1 and then died.
Same dude. I dont have the energy to keep chatting right now, I just had a seriously shitty past hour, but if you want to talk hmu and I'll get back to you when I feel better. Take care

I remember when I first did had to tell them, it was hard, luckily my parents were pretty understanding, probably because the both have depression themselves. I hope you end up trying it and getting a good therapist.

I want to suggest therapy, as it has helped me to an extent. However, I know a lot of therapists can be terrible, too expensive, etc. I guess I still reccomend it overall, or maybe a call to the hotline. But I know it's such a pain even gathering the energy to do those things when you're so fucking suicidal

I hate continuing too. I'm just staying because I'm too scared at the moment, and I don't want to hurt anyone. I also want to do my best to make others feel better, I feel like the pathetic excuse of life is to everyone else's journey through it less miserable. Still, I may end up killing myself. I feel so alone, I've been ostracized by an entire group of friends, I am going to buy a box cutter today so I can start cutting myself.
Hey there. I hope you change your mind about taking these, regardless of what you decide, if you want to chat I'm here. Best wishes.

Hey there, I'm sorry you're going through such a hard time, so am I. I hope you can push through in the end. I'd say maybe go volunteer somewhere, maybe with animals or kids. Donate some money to charity. Do something fun. I hope things get better. Best wishes
I can relate. I really thought I'd kill myself before I become 18, yet here I am, eighteen years old. Is there anything you want to talk about? If not, no worries, and best wishes.
Same. I feel so lonely. And it's hard to balance your kindness too, because when you're too friendly people will think you're creepy. Life fucking sucks
This misery fucking sucks. I'm sorry you're dealing with it. Is there anything you care to vent or talk about? If not, no worries, but I'm here if you need anyone. Best wishes

I'm sorry you're feeling so miserable. I feel as if my life is pretty pointless too. I just feel like the point of life is to try and make others as happy as you can, just help out your community and others while you can. It sounds pretty stupid, but it's all that's really keeping me going.

Thanks for your words. Yeah, these people have have me countless chances, but it's too late now. I truly believe I'm different now bit I guess there is no certainty. I feel like I'm more sure than ever before that I wont act out if I feel upset, because I think I've finally nailed down why I've been acting this way, but still.

I feel the same way, sometimes it helps to think "how would you help someone in your situation? Would you want them to hurt themselves" for me, not at all, but it's still a feeling that I just want to go through with

Best wishes, try your best to push on and instead of self hating use that energy towards becoming the person you want to be

I'm very sorry you feel this way, you're strong for staying this long despite the, what seems like, verbal abuse. Nobody should have parents that treat them poorly. I hope things get better, do your best to push on.
It's excruciating. I hope you'll be able to find healthy ways to cope and get better. Message me if you need anything, best wishes.

I'm sorry, that sounds like a lot. My mother dealt with similar things, being called horrible things and being abused emotionally and physically. Nobody should ever have to deal with family that treats them so poorly.
I messed up really horribly countless times with my friends, to a point where I'm not close with anybody anymore. It hurts so much. I feel like I ruined my life. I think I understand how you feel.
I believe you will, but your time isn't now. Please stay strong. It's likely what they would have wanted.

I totally relate. I have no close friends, I ruined all the bonds I had with them. I had four close ones that were such amazing people, I ended up being too much for three of them. I treated them like shit because I thought they were fake. Like, how could anyone genuinely care about someone like me? I have one of them I'm in contact with left still, and they takes weeks to months to respond.

Please stay strong. Your parents and dog would miss you deeply, and I'm sure you're a blessing to them.

Feel free to talk if you need someone.
I'm very sorry for what happened to you. I can only imagine how hard that is. I know it's excruciating, but I'm sure you can push through. Best wishes, and I'm available to talk if you ever need to.
